name: @workspec/site
description: The WorkSpec Studio site — free workbench over your WorkSpec artifacts, modules as paths (/decisions, /c4, and /cost, each with its own in-browser demo). Consumes the PUBLISHED @workspec/* packages from npm — if the site builds, those packages work for outside consumers. The @workspec/cost-* packages remain a workspace exception: the first manual cost publish (0.1.0-alpha.0) shipped a stale build missing current exports, so they stay workspace-linked until cost is republished from a fresh build — see docs/cost/drift-log.md.
_LOUD_NOTICE_devDependencies_cost_packag: The three @workspec/cost-* entries in devDependencies below are workspace:* — NOT registry pins like every other @workspec/* dependency above. Cost IS on npm now, but the first manual publish (0.1.0-alpha.0) packed a stale dist and is missing current public API (createMemoryRepository, CostApp, CostStudioProvider, attribute, …), so the site cannot consume it. Keep these workspace-linked until cost is republished from a fresh build (alpha.1+, ideally via the release workflow now that cost trusted publishers exist), then flip each to that registry version and move it up into "dependencies" — mirroring how PR #27 resolved the c4 exception (docs/c4/drift-log.md entry 17).
